# Synthetic audio

Generated by `python3 bench/generate_audio.py --ffmpeg /path/to/ffmpeg`.
The source is a deterministic sum of 440 Hz and 997 Hz sine waves, mono/stereo,
44.1/48 kHz, PCM16, 250 ms. Continuous/split recordings are one second total.
No provider audio or signed links are included. The six-channel WAV checks
rejection; it is not a supported playback format.

Initial encodings: FFmpeg 9.0 (imageio-ffmpeg 0.8.1 macOS arm64 distribution),
libmp3lame, native AAC-LC, FLAC, libvorbis, libopus. WAV files use Python wave.
Regenerating with another encoder version can change compressed bytes.

These generated recordings are distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later.

Long VBR fixtures contain eight seconds alternating silence and deterministic
chirps, generated by the same script. MP3 variants include and omit Xing/LAME
metadata; ADTS AAC has no trustworthy trim count. Tests require all source frames
to survive decoding and compare MP3 seek output against continuous decoding.
